segments.text: 13. MOreover, It will do much to the better ordering of families, and better ſpending of the Lords day. When we have once got the Maſter of the family to undertake it, that he will once every Lords day examine his family, and hear them what they can ſay of the Catechiſm, it will find them the moſt profitable imployment: whereas otherwiſe, many of them would be idle, or ill employed: And many Maſters that know little themſelves, may yet be brought to do this for others.
